completion_promises.criterion_text: KeycloakIdentityProvider implements the 3-member IdentityProvider port unchanged, with a sync currentPrincipal backed by an in-memory cached principal
completion_promises.evidence: KeycloakIdentityProvider in app/lib/adapters/keycloak_identity_provider.dart implements IdentityProvider with sync currentPrincipal getter, async signIn(), and async signOut(). The currentPrincipal is backed by _currentPrincipal field updated after token operations.

completion_promises.criterion_text: signIn() attempts a silent refresh of the stored session before opening the browser, and opens the interactive PKCE S256 browser flow only when silent refresh is unavailable/fails
completion_promises.evidence: _performSignIn() checks stored session and expiry, attempts _silentRefresh() first using FlutterAppAuth.token(). On failure or absence, falls back to _interactiveSignIn() using authorizeAndExchangeCode(). PKCE S256 is flutter_appauth default.

completion_promises.criterion_text: The interactive flow uses KeycloakConfig.redirectUrl (com.appmilla.studytutor:/oauth2redirect) and requests offline_access, and completes after the custom-scheme redirect returns the app to the foreground
completion_promises.evidence: Interactive flow uses AuthorizationTokenRequest with _config.clientId, _config.redirectUrl, _config.issuer, and _config.scopes (includes 'offline_access'). KeycloakConfig enforces these values.

completion_promises.criterion_text: signIn() surfaces cancel and failure as distinct outcomes (§4 SIGNIN_OUTCOME) and never conflates them
completion_promises.evidence: SignInCancelled and SignInFailed are distinct exception types. _interactiveSignIn() catches FlutterAppAuthPlatformException and uses _isCancelError() to distinguish cancel (CANCELED code) from failures, throwing appropriate exception type.

completion_promises.criterion_text: A second signIn() while one is in flight starts no second flow (single-flight)
completion_promises.evidence: Single-flight guard using _signInInFlight field. signIn() checks if a Future is in flight and returns it instead of starting new flow. Field cleared when Future completes.

completion_promises.criterion_text: The adapter refreshes proactively before access-token expiry using the appauth token-response expiry, so an idle longer than the access-token lifetime does not force a re-sign-in while the offline session is valid (KC-G3)
completion_promises.evidence: _scheduleProactiveRefresh() schedules Timer to refresh 5 minutes before expiry using response.accessTokenExpirationDateTime. Called after successful token operations. _performBackgroundRefresh() executes refresh and updates cached principal.

completion_promises.criterion_text: signOut() clears the secure store and cached principal and wins over an in-flight background refresh — a refresh completing after sign-out does not restore the session
completion_promises.evidence: Generation-based epoch using _generation counter. signOut() increments _generation, cancels refresh timer, clears principal and store. All refresh operations capture generation at start and check before updating principal, discarding updates if generation changed.

completion_promises.criterion_text: An unrecoverable background refresh leaves currentPrincipal == null and degrades to the sign-in fallback rather than crashing or hanging
completion_promises.evidence: _performBackgroundRefresh() has try-catch. On token refresh exception, clears _currentPrincipal and store if generation hasn't changed. Never propagates exceptions to callers of currentPrincipal (which is sync).

completion_promises.criterion_text: At launch an absent/unreadable/offline-expired stored session is treated as signed out
completion_promises.evidence: _performSignIn() checks storedSession for null and expiry using _isExpired(). If absent, unreadable (SecureSessionStore returns null), or expired, skips silent refresh and goes to interactive flow. No initialization sets principal at launch.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Hermetic tests fake FlutterAppAuth and SecureSessionStore — no browser, no network, no platform channel
completion_promises.evidence: FakeAppAuth implementing FlutterAppAuth and FakeSecureSessionStore implementing SecureSessionStore in test file. Tests inject fakes via constructor. No real platform channels or network calls in tests.
